# Source-only Optimal price observations

The 147 deterministic version-2 requests contain 9,835,338 source bytes and 2,018
bounded operations. They are pre-execution hypotheses, with no observed or
predicted C statistics/prices. The packet and source hashes bind regenerated
inputs, not accepted output.

Coverage includes predefined/dynamic initialization, compressed/disabled literal
pricing, every LL/ML symbol interval, encoded offset powers, histogram scaling,
whole-bit count boundaries, retained dirty caches and repeated rescaling. Batched
updates reach sequence-table scale thresholds without arbitrary state seeding.

Run `python3 scripts/check_optimal_price_recipes.py` for exact manifest and
transport replay. The checker forbids child execution. Extra-bit constants are
derived from facebook/zstd v1.5.7; attribution is retained in NOTICE/LICENSE.zstd.
Public Optimal remains unsupported; the independent observation model and C
helper/capture gates follow this input freeze.
